# GraphicalLoader { #timetoalign.loader.graphical.GraphicalLoader }

```python
loader.graphical.GraphicalLoader(metadata=None)
```

Factory for building GraphicalStore objects.

The loader accumulates sources and segments, then builds a store.
This provides a fluent interface for constructing graphical timelines.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> loader = GraphicalLoader()
>>> idx = loader.add_image("score.png")
>>> loader.add_horizontal_segment(idx, x0=10, x1=500, y=100, name="system_1")
>>> loader.add_horizontal_segment(idx, x0=10, x1=500, y=200, name="system_2")
>>> store = loader.store
```

```python
>>> # From PDF
>>> import pymupdf
>>> doc = pymupdf.open("score.pdf")
>>> loader = GraphicalLoader()
>>> idx = loader.add_pdf_page(doc, 0)
>>> loader.add_horizontal_segment(idx, x0=50, x1=550, y=100, name="page1")
```

### add_horizontal_segment { #timetoalign.loader.graphical.GraphicalLoader.add_horizontal_segment }

```python
loader.graphical.GraphicalLoader.add_horizontal_segment(
    source_index,
    x0,
    x1,
    y,
    name=None,
    offset=None,
    tolerance=10.0,
)
```

Add a horizontal line segment (convenience method).

This is the most common case for musical scores and spectrograms.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                     | Description                                     | Default    |
|--------------|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------|------------|
| source_index | [int](`int`)             | Index of the source image.                      | _required_ |
| x0           | [float](`float`)         | Starting x coordinate (left edge).              | _required_ |
| x1           | [float](`float`)         | Ending x coordinate (right edge).               | _required_ |
| y            | [float](`float`)         | Fixed y coordinate (vertical position).         | _required_ |
| name         | [str](`str`) \| None     | Optional human-readable name.                   | `None`     |
| offset       | [float](`float`) \| None | Timeline offset. If None, appends contiguously. | `None`     |
| tolerance    | [float](`float`)         | Distance tolerance for coordinate conversion.   | `10.0`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                        | Description                   |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------|
|        | [GraphicalSegment](`timetoalign.loader.graphical.segment.GraphicalSegment`) | The created GraphicalSegment. |
